text: Implemented bounded per-position run status lookup and single patterned child-axis indexing. Shared semantics and complete StatMap allocation regressions pass JVM 9/9 and JS 7/7. Full-vector mutation failed both export allocation budgets; byte-exact restoration then both gates passed. At 4096 voxels allocation fell from ~164 MB to 4.44 MB runwise / 4.31 MB patterned (~97% reduction). Evidence: docs/verification/export-allocation-20261005/receipt.json. Awaiting parent full fit JVM+JS integration gate before completion.
